meta.type_translation_desc: Type the translation for the prompt. Correct or wrong, it grades the card just like a swipe.
meta.recall_from_definition_desc: Read the definition and type the word it describes. Like a swipe, it grades the card.
meta.cloze_free_desc: Type the missing word in an example sentence. You produce the answer from memory, so it grades the card like a swipe.
meta.multiple_choice_desc: Pick the translation from a few options. A wrong pick reschedules the card, but a correct pick never changes when it’s next due.
meta.word_bank_cloze_desc: Pick the missing word in an example sentence from a bank of options. A wrong pick reschedules the card; a correct pick never changes when it’s next due.
meta.reverse_mc_desc: See the target word and pick the matching prompt. A wrong pick reschedules the card; a correct pick never changes when it’s next due.
meta.memory_grid_desc: Match prompts to their answers in a quick warm-up or cool-down. Purely for fun — it never changes your schedule.
meta.synonym_match_desc: In a cool-down, pick the words that share a meaning with an answer. Builds your vocabulary-depth stat — a different skill that never changes when a card is next due.
meta.speed_round_desc: A fast burst of multiple-choice questions between rounds. Just for practice — it never changes when a card is next due.
meta.scramble_desc: Unscramble the letters of a word as a quick cool-down. Purely for fun — it never changes your schedule.
meta.hangman_desc: Guess a word letter by letter as a cool-down. Purely for fun — it never changes your schedule.
meta.listening_desc: Hear a brand-new word read aloud, then reveal how it’s spelled. Practice only — it never changes when a card is next due.
